content: yt-dlp breaks intermittently as YouTube changes its signature/cipher and bot-detection ('Sign in to confirm you're not a bot'); yt-dlp maintainers typically ship fixes within hours to days. Cloud/datacenter IPs (AWS, GCP, Render, etc.) are disproportionately flagged as bots because of shared reputation-poor IP ranges; workarounds include browser cookie auth, PO (proof-of-origin) token providers, Android client spoofing, sleep-interval throttling, and residential proxies -- all of which add operational fragility and cost for a server-side extraction feature.
